lines.en: I flutter over the grass tips.

lines.zh: 翅膀一下一下，我在找花。
lines.en: Wingbeat by wingbeat, I hunt for flowers.
I fly low to the ground to dodge the wind.
I go from this flower to that one.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀很小，扇得很快。
lines.en: My wings are small and beat fast.
I veer around a stand of tall leaves.

lines.zh: 我飘了一阵，落在一根枝上。
lines.en: I drift a while and settle on a twig.
I fly at an angle, as if pushed by wind.
I head for that clump of poppies.
I fly the length of the hedge.
I stop on a flower to rest.

lines.zh: 我又起飞，翅膀扬得很高。
lines.en: I take off again with wings lifted high.
I skirt the web and fly the edge.
I cross a puddle and see my reflection.
I fly toward the sunlit side.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降下来，落在叶上。
lines.en: I descend slowly and land on a leaf.
I perch, wings opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我吸着花蜜，触角轻轻动。
lines.en: I sip nectar and my antennae stir.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的翅膀照亮了。
lines.en: Sunlight brightens my wings.
I lie on the petal and still my wings.
A gust carries me off line.
I shake my wings and smooth them.

lines.zh: 花上有一滴露水，我避开了。
lines.en: There is dew on the flower and I avoid it.
My life is short, so I must keep flying.
I wait for the sun to warm a little more.

lines.zh: 我看见远处还有一片花。
lines.en: I see more flowers further off.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合起来，像片叶子。
lines.en: I close my wings and look like a leaf.
I listen to the sounds around me.

lines.zh: 我飞到你面前，停了一下。
lines.en: I fly up before you and pause.
Your colors stand out.
I fly half a circle by you.
I pause on your shoulder for a moment.
You move and I take off.
I settle on the flower by your hand.
I am close, but I do not touch you.

lines.zh: 我看你的影子，比看你久。
lines.en: I watch your shadow longer than you.
You are blocking the sun.
I fly two paces off and come back.
The blow sends me dropping.

lines.zh: 翅缘缺了一小块，飞不稳。
lines.en: A chip off my wing edge makes my flight wobble.
I fly crooked and cannot settle.
I hit a leaf and finally stop.
I lie there a while before rising.
Half my strength is gone.
I hide deep in the grass.
I can still fly, but slowly.
I keep that in my wing veins.
I will not live much longer.
The smell of nectar draws me.

lines.zh: 我朝你手上的花飞过去。
lines.en: I fly toward the flower in your hand.

lines.zh: 我停在花瓣边上，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I settle on the petal edge and sip slowly.
This poppy is at its peak.
When I finish I move to another.

lines.zh: 我蹭到了花粉，腿上都是。
lines.en: I brushed the pollen and my legs are dusted.

lines.zh: 你举着别动，我马上就好。
lines.en: Hold it still; I will be quick.
I step twice across the petal.
I eat nothing else; I only drink this.

lines.zh: 你把花放下，我就飞过去。
lines.en: Set the flower down and I will fly to it.
The knock sends me flying crooked.
I am thrown a good way off.
I flap to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这么轻的身子，撞一下就飞。
lines.en: A body this light is knocked flying.

lines.zh: 我撞在你手上，又飞起来。
lines.en: I hit your hand and fly up again.
I settle back on the flower as if nothing happened.
I veer round your shoulder and pass.

lines.zh: 这么近，我差点贴到你的脸。
lines.en: That close, I nearly touched your face.
I back off to the flowering side.
You are too strong for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着它飞，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I fly around it, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 我们翅挨着翅，停在一处。
lines.en: Wing to wing, we settle in one place.
It takes off and I follow.

lines.zh: 我们的翅膀几乎碰在一起。
lines.en: Our wings nearly touch.

lines.zh: 我们上下起伏，节奏一样。
lines.en: We rise and dip in the same rhythm.
I land on the leaf beside it.

lines.zh: 我一靠近，它就飞开一点。
lines.en: I come close and it drifts a little off.
We circle the flower twice.
It flies into the wood and I go too.
We scatter and meet again.
I settle in the flower's heart and sip.
I hold the stamen with my forelegs.
This flower is too small.
I taste it; it is very faint.
The nectar sticks to my feet.
I brush against it and carry pollen off.
This one has already been drained.
I settle on another.

lines.zh: 我蹭下一层粉，替它授粉。
lines.en: I leave a dusting of pollen behind.
I take only a little, no more.

lines.zh: 有影子掠过，我立刻飞起。
lines.en: A shadow passes and I take off at once.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那团动的影子。
lines.en: I fix on that moving shape.
I hover first to see clearly.
It is too close, so I fly higher.
I duck behind a leaf first.
I circle, waiting for it to leave.
The wind carries it toward me.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合上，装成叶子。
lines.en: I close my wings and pass for a leaf.
I see it now; it is not a flower.
One move will give me away.
I circle above it.
When it moves, I rise.
I withdraw among the leaves.
I keep my eyes on its hands.
I cling to the leaf's underside and dare not stir.
It hasn't gone; it's still below the bloom.
I count how many times it breathes.
I want to leave but fear being seen.
The wind hides me from it.
One more moment and I fly.
I beat my wings against it once.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，像落下一粒灰。
lines.en: I dart in, light as a fleck of ash.
My body has little strength.

lines.zh: 这一下连花粉都没抖落。
lines.en: That did not even shake off the pollen.
I hurry away.
I swing back for one more bump.
It swats and I retreat.
I am not made for fighting.
I settle on a twig to catch my breath.
I am done fighting.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里出来，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of the chrysalis with soft wings.
I hang under the leaf and slowly spread them.
The first thing I do is look for flowers.
My wings have finally dried.
I try a short flight.
There are many flowers this season.
I circle this patch of flowers.
The wind pushes me off course.
The sun is warm and I rise.
I have only a few days left.

lines.zh: 火苗把我的翅膀烤卷了。
lines.en: Flame curls my wings.

lines.zh: 摔在土上，翅上的粉蹭掉了。
lines.en: I hit the soil and rub the dust off one wing.

lines.zh: 水把我粘住，翅膀展不开。
lines.en: Water glues me and my wings will not open.

lines.zh: 爆风把我卷过整片草地。
lines.en: The blast rolls me clear across the meadow.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过我的翅，撕开一道。
lines.en: Something grazes my wing and tears it.

lines.zh: 一股冷意罩住我，飞不起来。
lines.en: Cold settles over me and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 太久没喝到蜜，我没劲了。
lines.en: Too long without nectar and I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我吓得贴在叶上。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I press flat to the leaf.

lines.zh: 风把我卷起来，一直往下。
lines.en: The wind takes me and I fall away.
